title: ScoredChunk
description: A retrieval hit: a full Chunk shape (per chunk.schema.json) plus a cosine-similarity score. Returned by VectorStore.search (docs/contracts/vector-store-interface.md). Composition over Chunk rather than field-duplication so the chunk shape has one source of truth.

chunk.description: The full Chunk shape; mirrors what is stored in the chunks table after the vector-store adapter joins the Postgres row back onto the vector payload.

score.description: Cosine similarity between the query vector and the chunk's stored embedding. Higher is more similar.
